message.content: {"caption":"A two-part evaluation figure pairs a training-progress line chart with a table comparing model scores and score gains.","description":"Panel (a) is a line chart of In-Distribution Accuracy (vertical axis, about 0.30–0.70) against Training Steps (horizontal axis, 50–250). Its legend identifies four series: blue AZR-Llama3.1-8b, orange AZR-3B-Coder, red AZR-7B-Coder, and teal AZR-14B-Coder. The blue series rises from about 0.37 to 0.43 at 100 steps, dips to about 0.41 at 150, then is about 0.42 at 200. The orange series rises from about 0.37 through 0.43 and 0.46 at 100 and 150 steps, then edges down to about 0.45 at 200 and 0.44 at 250. The red series increases from about 0.53 to 0.58 by 100 steps, stays near 0.58 at 150 and 200, and reaches about 0.60 at 250. The teal series starts around 0.65, remains level at 100, then increases to about 0.68, 0.69, and 0.72 at 150, 200, and 250 steps. These line-chart values are estimated read-offs, not printed point labels. Panel (b) is a table with columns Model Family, Variant, Code Avg, Math Avg, and Total Avg. The printed rows are: Llama3.1-8b, no variant: 28.5, 3.4, 16.0; Llama3.1-8b, + SimpleRL: 33.7 (+5.2), 7.2 (+3.8), 20.5 (+4.5); Llama3.1-8b, + AZR (Ours): 31.6 (+3.1), 6.8 (+3.4), 19.2 (+3.2); Qwen2.5-3B Coder, no variant: 51.2, 18.8, 35.0; Qwen2.5-3B Coder, + AZR (Ours): 54.9 (+3.7), 26.5 (+7.7), 40.7 (+5.7); Qwen2.5-7B Coder, no variant: 56.6, 23.9, 40.2; Qwen2.5-7B Coder, + AZR (Ours): 61.6 (+5.0), 39.1 (+15.2), 50.4 (+10.2); Qwen2.5-14B Coder, no variant: 60.0, 20.2, 40.1; Qwen2.5-14B Coder, + AZR (Ours): 63.6 (+3.6), 43.0 (+22.8), 53.3 (+13.2). The gains are printed in green beside the corresponding scores. AZR rows have pale-blue shading, the SimpleRL row is gray, and baseline rows are unshaded.
